name: Kraken Import
description: Reads your Kraken history — purchases, deposits, withdrawals and staking rewards — and imports it into Wealthfolio.
author: Lev Kargalov

permissions.purpose: Read your balances and history from api.kraken.com. Only query endpoints are called: the addon never places an order, moves Earn funds, or withdraws.

Keep your Kraken API key and private key in the keyring. Unlike a broker the host can authenticate for us, Kraken signs each request with an HMAC over a nonce and the request body, so the addon must read the private key back to compute that signature. 'use' is not requested — the host cannot build this header itself.

Let you pick which Wealthfolio account the imported history belongs to, or create a new one named by you. Kraken holds balances per asset and has no account currency, so the connector asks which one to use.
Write the mapped history once you confirm, and recognise what was already imported so a repeat sync adds only what is new.
Ask Wealthfolio to revalue the portfolio after an import, and read back your holdings to check each Kraken asset resolved to the right symbol.

Look up ticker symbols while you correct one, fetch prices for the assets an import introduces so a fresh install is not left reporting missing rates, and refresh a specific asset after its price source is changed to Kraken's own Ticker.
Read the currency Wealthfolio assigned to each imported asset and correct it when it disagrees with the one Kraken states.
Read the source of each asset's latest quote, so the addon can confirm that a price actually came from Kraken rather than reporting success because a stale price happened to still be there.
